items.title: Lilly agrees to buy Calytrix Bio for up to $1.5bn
items.summary: Eli Lilly is acquiring Massachusetts biotech Calytrix Bio, which develops treatments for myelofibrosis and essential thrombocythaemia (myeloproliferative neoplasms), for up to $1.5bn including milestones; upfront cash was not disclosed.
